text: ほらっ　ほらっ　みてみて　ぼくの　じまんの　シールなんだー　こんなに　いっぱい　あるんだぜー　ほしい？

structure.jp: ほらっ　ほらっ　みてみて
ぼくの　じまんの　シールなんだー
structure.en: these are the stickers I'm proud of

structure.jp: こんなに　いっぱい　あるんだぜー

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb on its own is a casual 'please do'; saying it twice adds eagerness. みてみて = 'look, look!'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: なんだ adds the feeling of explaining or showing something off. シールなんだー = 'they're my stickers, see'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, boyish speech that pushes the statement at the listener. あるんだぜー = 'I've got them, you know!'.
